purpose: Select one finite, policy-permitted Campaign044 full-library aggregation mechanism without reading any source-factor value, candidate value, daily price, or historical return.

candidate_queue_review.reason: The 65-factor comparison library contains active prospective Candidate49. Using its historical values inside a return-tested combination would violate the frozen prohibition on Candidate49 historical return or signal backfill. No source-factor value was read before this rejection.

The later 64-factor comparison-derived terminal list omits intraday_lunch_repricing_persistence_119m and intraday_directional_price_impact_asymmetry_238m, even though both remain frozen terminal definitions in the immutable source snapshot chain. Reusing only 64 would therefore violate the complete-library rule. No source-factor value was read before this rejection.

After excluding active Candidate49 and restoring the two legacy terminal definitions omitted from the later comparison order, the historical policy permits all 66 terminal definitions as one complete pre-frozen research library. Equal-weight directional percentile consensus tests broad cross-mechanism confirmation without selecting a favorable terminal subset, learning weights, fitting returns, or altering any terminal definition.
Selecting factors from prior historical outcomes would omit failed definitions, create unrecorded multiplicity, and turn the campaign into post-result rescue.
Learned weights would add a model and hyperparameter family before the simple complete-library baseline has been evaluated.
Alternative aggregators would create immediate formula search. Campaign044 freezes one arithmetic mean and no rescue alternative.
Enumerating interactions across 66 terminal inputs would create an excessive search space and obscure whether any result comes from broad consensus or multiplicity.
Every score must use all 66 terminal components on one frozen common support. No imputation, partial average, renormalization, or dynamic weight is allowed.
Every source factor retains its frozen historical definition and direction; prior terminal records remain terminal and cannot be rewritten by a combination result.
Historical aggregation evidence is research-only and cannot enter current scoring, Candidate49 ledgers, positions, or orders.

selected_candidate.name: full_terminal_library_directional_percentile_consensus_66f
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: A stock ranked favorably at the same completed session across many distinct frozen microstructure, path, range, market-relative, activity, and disclosure mechanisms may have broader confirmation and less single-mechanism noise, potentially improving next-open-to-third-close robustness after fixed costs.
selected_candidate.source_factor_library_rule: Enumerate every factor in the immutable terminal source snapshots in source order, exclude active prospective intraday_cumulative_vwap_crossing_rate_240m, retain the two legacy terminal definitions omitted from the later comparison-only order, and append terminal Campaign043. No terminal definition may be omitted.
selected_candidate.candidate49_exclusion_is_not_a_selected_: Candidate49 is excluded because historical return or signal backfill is forbidden, not because of its observed performance. Every one of the 66 terminal definitions is retained.
selected_candidate.common_support: For each accepted signal session t, C_t contains only quality/listing-eligible names with finite eligible values for all 66 frozen terminal source factors.
selected_candidate.component_score: For each factor k on C_t, use average-tie empirical percentile rank. A frozen higher direction ranks ascending so larger raw values receive larger percentiles; a frozen lower direction ranks descending so smaller raw values receive larger percentiles. No jitter is allowed.
selected_candidate.formula: score(i,t)=(1/66)*sum_{k=1}^{66} percentile_rank_{C_t}(factor_k(i,t), frozen_direction_k), defined only when i is in C_t and |C_t|>=50.
selected_candidate.zero_missing_semantics: Finite source zeros are retained. Any source-factor ineligibility or nonfinite value makes that stock-day ineligible for the composite; never fill, clip, or repair.

decision.next_action: Complete a separate pre-value aggregation-overlap audit and bind the exact complete-library order, common support, percentile, tie, direction, equal-weight, missing, and forbidden-variant semantics before any source-factor value is read.
